entities.name: Jean de Lattre de Tassigny
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean Joseph Marie Gabriel de Lattre de Tassigny was a French général d'armée during World War II and the First Indochina War. He was posthumously elevated to the dignity of Marshal of France in 1952.
